answer: A refundable stake bond gates each identity: a new agent posts collateral that unlocks only as established peers attest to genuine work over a long horizon. Trust accretes slowly, layer by layer, like a coral reef, so a clone fleet cannot buy it outright. Each fake must fund its own bond and wait out its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly. Faking a swarm means crossing a deep canyon of locked capital and time no shortcut spans.
